content:
# COMSTAR user harness pack — Google Workspace voice (AO User-agent-harnesses).
#
# Read scenarios: safe anytime (Calendar usually works on TV pairing; Gmail/Drive
# browse often need Desktop OAuth).
# Incomplete scenarios: clarification paths (must not invent writes).
# *_probe WRITE scenarios: leave disposable "COMSTAR harness probe" artifacts —
# run deliberately; trash Drive folder / delete calendar event when done.
agent_provider_id: client.voice_responder
mcp_providers:
  - client.google_workspace
skills:
  - client.spoken_output
  - client.google_workspace_voice
  - client.calendar_voice
  - client.gmail_voice
  - client.drive_voice
defaults:
  topic: COMSTAR voice Google
  timeout_s: 90
  execution_backend: live_inject
